icp_text:
Fit: B2B logistics or freight software or services companies with 100-500 employees, headquartered in North America.
Behavior: hired or is hiring its first revenue operations or billing operations person in the last 12 months; runs three or more regional offices.
Pain: reconciles invoices or billing across many counterparties by hand or in spreadsheets; staff complain about invoice disputes eating finance time.
Timing: raised a Series A or later round in the last 12 months.
Constraints: North America only; no agencies or consultancies.
Same industry alone is not a fit.

report.title: Lookalike profile: Northwind Freight
report.summary: Northwind Freight bought right after its first RevOps hire, while reconciling carrier invoices in spreadsheets and growing finance after a Series B. Lookalikes are weighted on those behavior, pain and timing signals; logistics industry and size count for little.
